# Setup

```{r Setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE,
                      comment=NA,
                      prompt=FALSE,
                      cache=FALSE)
```

## Clear workspace

```{r Clear worksapce}
rm(list = ls())
```


Read in file with path to ilovedata channel on Teams
```{r Read in paths file}
source(file = "credentials/paths.R")
```


Add the add_numeric function - used to convert character variables into numeric variables.
Add the sumscores function - used to generate sumscores
Add the package_check function - used to install and load dependencies
```{r Read in functions}
source(file = paste0(ilovedata_scripts, "functions/add_numeric.R"))
source(file = paste0(ilovedata_scripts, "functions/remove_duplicates.R"))
source(file = paste0(ilovedata_scripts, "functions/sumscores.R"))
source(file = paste0(ilovedata_scripts, "functions/package_check.R"))
source(file = paste0(ilovedata_scripts, "functions/imp_check.R"))
source(file = paste0(ilovedata_scripts, "functions/recode_check.R"))
```

# Exclusion criteria

-555 'Not applicable' response from participant
-666 Implausible response/value
-777 Seen but not answered
-888 Don't know
-999 Prefer not to answer/Prefer not to say

```{r table before exclusion}
dat %>%
  select(
    age,
    gender,
    sex,
    ethnicity,
    sexual_orientation,
    height_m,
    bmi,
    dem.highest_education_collapsed,
    #phq9.sum_score,
    any_mdd_diagnosis,
    any_gad_diagnosis,
  "mhd.mdd",
  "mhd.gad",
  "mhd.social_anxiety",
  "mhd.specific_phobia",
  "mhd.agoraphobia",
  "mhd.panic_disorder",
  "mhd.panic_attacks",
  "mhd.bipolar_disorder",
  "mhd.ocd",
  "mhd.bdd",
  "mhd.an",
  "mhd.atypical_an",
  "mhd.bn",
  "mhd.bed",
  "mhd.schizophrenia",
  "mhd.ptsd",  
  "mhd.addadhd",
  
  "mhd.perinatal_depression",
  "mhd.depressive_disorders",
  "mhd.anxiety_disorders" 
) %>%
  gtsummary::tbl_summary()
```


# Exclusion manually

## gender

```{r Exclusion gender}
dim(dat)

nogender <- dat %>%
  drop_na(gender)

missing_gender <- abs(nrow(nogender)-nrow(dat))
missing_gender
```

## sexual orientation

```{r Exclusion sexual orientation}
dim(nogender)


nogender.nosexualorientation <- nogender %>%
  drop_na(sexual_orientation)

missing_sexualorientation <- 
  nrow(nogender) - 
  nrow(nogender.nosexualorientation)
missing_sexualorientation
```

## Final

Final *n* = `r abs(nrow(nogender))`for gender

```{r name}
dat_after_exclusion_gender <- 
  nogender
nrow(dat_after_exclusion_gender)
```

Final *n* = `r abs(nrow(nogender.nosexualorientation))`for sexual orientation

```{r name}
dat_after_exclusion_sexual_orientation <- 
  nogender.nosexualorientation
nrow(dat_after_exclusion_sexual_orientation)
```

## Flowchart

```{r flowchart exclusison}
n_total <- 55811 # from data_creation

n_inconsistent_gender <- n_total - nrow(dat)
n_remaining_consistent_gender <- nrow(dat)  # inconsistent gender, sex and transgender question

n_missing_gender <- nrow(dat) - nrow(nogender)
n_remaining_gender <- nrow(nogender)


n_missing_sexual <- nrow(nogender) - nrow(nogender.nosexualorientation)
n_remaining_sexual <- nrow(nogender.nosexualorientation)

n_total_f <- format(n_total, big.mark = ",")
n_inconsistent_gender_f <- format(n_inconsistent_gender, big.mark = ",")
n_remaining_consistent_gender_f <- format(n_remaining_consistent_gender, big.mark = ",")
n_missing_gender_f <- format(n_missing_gender, big.mark = ",")
n_remaining_gender_f <- format(n_remaining_gender, big.mark = ",")
n_missing_sexual_f <- format(n_missing_sexual, big.mark = ",")
n_remaining_sexual_f <- format(n_remaining_sexual, big.mark = ",")

# Flowchart
flowchart <- grViz(sprintf("
digraph flowchart {
    graph [layout = dot, rankdir = TB, fontsize=12]

    node [shape = box, style=solid, color=black, fontname=Helvetica, width=2]
    
    start [label='Start\\n(n = %s)']
    consistent_gender [label='Consistent Gender inforamation\\n(n = %s)']
    with_gender [label='With Gender\\n(n = %s)']
    with_sexual [label='With Sexual Orientation\\n(n = %s)']

    start -> consistent_gender [label='Excluded: Inconsistent Gender information\\n(n = %s)', labeljust=l, labelangle=-45, labeldistance=5.0]
    consistent_gender -> with_gender [label='Excluded: Missing Gender\\n(n = %s)', labeljust=l, labelangle=-45, labeldistance=5.0]
    with_gender ->  with_sexual [label='Excluded: Missing Sexual Orientation\\n(n = %s)', labeljust=l, labelangle=-45, labeldistance=5.0]
}
", 
n_total_f, 
n_remaining_consistent_gender_f, 
n_remaining_gender_f, 
n_remaining_sexual_f,
n_inconsistent_gender_f, 
n_missing_gender_f, 
n_missing_sexual_f))

flowchart

```


```{r safe figure}
rsvg_png(charToRaw(export_svg(flowchart)), 
        file.path(filepath_plots, "flowchart.png"),
         width = 1500, 
         height = 1000 
)
```

